summary.en-US: Connect local tools to browser tabs through a Native Messaging bridge.

description.en-US: List nonprivate tabs and activate existing tabs from local applications. Requires the separately installed macOS native host and Node.js. Setup: https://github.com/sandzhaj/Zen-Browser-Bridge#install-macos . Transmits tab URLs and titles only to local applications running as your user; no remote server or analytics.

version.approval_notes: Requires the macOS Native Messaging host. Host source and setup are at https://github.com/sandzhaj/Zen-Browser-Bridge . No build step or minification; addon/ is the complete browser source. Data is sent only to local clients.
